translation: Therefore Wei Boyang's Cantong Qi says: When the upper is closed it is called having; when the lower is closed it is called not having; the not-having is used to serve the upper, and above dwells spiritual virtue; in the method of these two orifice points, the metal qi also mutually requires [them]. Cui Xifan's Tianyuan Ruyao Jing says: The upper magpie bridge, the lower magpie bridge; heaven responds with stars, earth responds with tides; return to the root orifice, cover the life gate, pierce the weilii (tailbone), and open the niwan (brain). The Dadao Sanzhang Zhizhi says: In the practitioner of elixir cultivation, there is one orifice in the body called the xuanpin (mysterious female).
